direction: Read this opening of a serious, cinematic Minecraft mystery short.
lines: Every night at midnight, the bell in Milo's village rings once. Tonight... it rang twice.
Okay. Okay, that's... not normal. Who is ringing that bell?

direction: Read this scene from a serious, cinematic Minecraft mystery short: a dark house at night.
lines: The last time the bell rang twice, I was younger than you. Bar the door. Don't open it. Not for anyone.
But the iron golem is still outside! He'll keep us safe... won't he?

direction: Read this scene from a serious, cinematic Minecraft mystery short: a forge, late at night.
lines: Iron's iron. It bends, it breaks, I fix it. Now stop staring at my anvil and tell me what you want.
Nothing you can forge. The bell isn't ringing for you... It's ringing for the boy.

direction: Read these two lines from a serious, cinematic Minecraft mystery short.
lines: You found the second village. Clever. Now you know why nobody who finds it ever goes home.
Milo? Sweetheart, it's late. Come inside, dinner's getting cold. And close the door behind you.

direction: Read this exchange from a serious, cinematic Minecraft mystery short: three in the morning, at a front door.
lines: Dude. It's three in the morning. Why are you at my door holding a torch?
The bell rang twice. I need you to come with me. Now.
Twice? No way. Okay. Okay, give me two seconds, I'm grabbing my sword.
(whispering) Bring a bucket too. Trust me.
